notes:
Passed the fake-backend gate on the second run (G1-G9, no warnings); the evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored and unreviewed: no hardware was attached, and the loader refuses the R2 hardware backend until a human sets reviewed_by. The native class is pipettebot.gantry:GcodeGantry. NOT COVERED: fluid aspirate/dispense. The dPette is a separate USB device whose 6-byte protocol the clone delegates to the external dpette-usb-driver package (docs/hardware.md:21-25); the clone states no volume or flow bound, and PipetteBot.aspirate_at/dispense_at take raw x,y,z (src/pipettebot/bot.py:38-48) while cap.fluid.aspirate.v1 and cap.fluid.dispense.v1 require a labware/well source and target (deck geometry is deferred, src/pipettebot/bot.py:29-30). PipetteBot also has no native stop path, so the gantry entry is the one that can carry an e-stop. The home action homes X and Y only (G28 X Y) because the clone warns that G28 on Z can hang or crash after the print head is removed (docs/marlin-commands.md:107). The workspace bounds are operator_required because the clone states that soft limits are not enforced and hardcoded coordinates are untrusted (docs/hardware.md:206-207); site-limits.example.json is an example only, not a statement about any unit. The fake is an in-memory F0 stand-in with placeholder coordinates, not a recording of the device. check-report.json is generated by the gate; the digest above is the digest line the passing gate printed.
